clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: The Designer will create a brand identity for the Client: logo, colour palette, typography and a 20-page brand guideline.
clauses.simple: The designer will make a logo, colors, fonts, and a brand guide for the client.

clauses.title: Fees
clauses.text: The total fee for the project is Rs. 2,40,000.
clauses.simple: The total cost for the work is 2,40,000 rupees.

clauses.title: Payment
clauses.text: The fee will be paid within 90 days after the Client's final approval of all deliverables, at the Client's discretion.
clauses.simple: The client will pay the money within 90 days after they approve the final work.
clauses.reason: Payment within 90 days or at client discretion is unusual compared to 45 days.

clauses.title: Revisions
clauses.text: The Designer shall make unlimited revisions until the Client is fully satisfied.
clauses.simple: The designer must keep changing the work until the client is happy.
clauses.reason: Unlimited revisions are unusual; revision rounds should be defined.

clauses.title: Ownership
clauses.text: All designs, drafts and ideas become the property of the Client as soon as they are created, whether or not payment has been made.
clauses.simple: The client owns everything the designer makes immediately, even if they haven't paid yet.
clauses.reason: IP transferring upon creation before full payment is unusual.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: The Client may terminate this agreement at any time, without paying for work in progress.
clauses.simple: The client can end the contract whenever they want without paying for unfinished work.
clauses.reason: Termination without paying for work in progress is against fair practice.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: The Designer shall indemnify the Client against all losses, claims and damages of any kind, without limit.
clauses.simple: The designer is responsible for paying for any losses or legal problems the client faces.
clauses.reason: Unlimited liability and indemnity is unusual.

clauses.title: Exclusivity
clauses.text: During this agreement and for 12 months after it ends, the Designer shall not work for any other retail brand.
clauses.simple: The designer cannot work for other retail companies during the contract or for one year after it ends.
clauses.reason: Exclusivity lasting 12 months after contract ends is against the law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Both parties shall keep each other's confidential information private.
clauses.simple: Both sides must keep each other's secrets safe.

clauses.title: Timeline
clauses.text: The first concepts will be delivered within 3 weeks of signing.
clauses.simple: The first ideas must be sent within three weeks of signing the contract.

missing.label: Late payment interest
missing.why: Protects freelancer against delayed payments via interest.

missing.label: Dispute resolution
missing.why: Essential to define how legal conflicts are settled.
